plan.title: Technical NDA acceptance with clause-free RFQ

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical Stage and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the single required line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Schedule both stages before publishing.
Invite the available QA vendor for Vendor A's session.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the Technical Stage before the RFQ pricing round.
Accept the required NDA clause as the vendor.
Submit the vendor's technical response after accepting the NDA.
Confirm the technical response was submitted.
Open the RFQ pricing stage.
Confirm the RFQ stage does not show the Technical Stage NDA clause or acceptance block.
Confirm the RFQ bid was accepted by the vendor portal.
